title: Has government imposed 5 per cent GST on e-commerce delivery services ahead of Diwali? Income Tax Dept says this
summary: Recent speculation on social media suggests that a new GST has been introduced for e-commerce delivery services. However, the Press Information Bureau has clarified that instead, the GST rate has been lowered from 18% to 5%. This amendment was part of the 57th GST Council meeting recommendations, aiming for a standardized tax structure.

direction_reasons: No clear directional signal in the available text
watch_next: confirmation from an official or company source
